always_on_pillars.name: What Does Your Swing Say?
always_on_pillars.description: TrackMan data + swing analysis. swing-shack has 4 TrackMan 4 bays + the first TrackMan iO in SA.

always_on_pillars.name: 10-Ball Truth
always_on_pillars.description: Pressure-test claims via the iO. Does it actually work?

always_on_pillars.name: Fitting
always_on_pillars.description: Custom TrackMan fitting — Takomo, Vice, L.A.B., LA Golf, Miura in-store.

events.name: Saints Sports Festival @ St Stithians (Randburg)
events.commercial_push: St Stithians College (Randburg) hosts the annual Saints Sports Festival — six sporting codes. Inter-school competition weekend. swing-shack is a 5-min drive from the campus. Family / spectator footfall day — TrackMan iO demo for parents while kids play.

pillars.coaching: Junior coaching sign-on coupon for festival families.

lanes.swing-truth: Free swing-analysis at swing-shack for any parent whose kid is in a sport.
lanes.campaign: Co-branded social with St Stithians golf team.

events.name: Joburg Ladies Open @ Randpark
events.commercial_push: Premier women's golf tournament on our doorstep. Randpark Firethorn course is closed 12-19 Apr; members and visitors get redirected to Old Parktonian (our home). A-PIN: fitting push + TrackMan iO demo + family spectator slot.

pillars.fitting: TrackMan iO demo window — book a fitting during tournament week.
pillars.coaching: Junior girls demo on weekend mornings.

lanes.swing-truth: TrackMan iO live demo data streamed in-store.
lanes.paid: Boosted posts within 5km radius of Randpark.
lanes.crm: Pre-event waitlist email to existing female members.

events.name: Heritage Day
events.commercial_push: SA public holiday, Thursday. swing-shack open Wednesday-Friday 09:00-21:00. No retail push — presence moment. Real heritage content via swing-shack's Truth-About / 10-Ball lanes.

pillars.retail: Open door. No offer. Heritage-month storytelling through Truth-About lane.

lanes.search: Long-tail 'golf indoor JHB' social proof peak.

events.name: Presidents Cup
events.commercial_push: Team-golf social play. swing-shack does not own this; no commercial arc. Light content beat via swing-truth lane. Downgraded from B-PIN: SA consumers respond weakly to non-SA team events.

pillars.retail: TrackMan team-format sim rounds — 'Pick your Presidents Cup team from the simulator' weekend.

lanes.swing-truth: Matchplay-format simulator rounds (best-ball, foursomes) over Presidents-Cup weekend.
lanes.campaign: Low-key 'follow it on the bay' remarketing.

events.name: Local Government Election Day
events.commercial_push: Wed 4 Nov 2026 LGE. Real SA public moment — non-golf. swing-shack stays open, foot traffic likely RE-DUCED Wed daytime. Engagement angle: voter-education + 'what's happening in our community' content parallel to the election. For Randburg single-store this matters more than for Paarl-Winelands. Hook: how decisions about local parks/public land shape urban golf access; relevant for swing-shack members.

pillars.retail: Open door. No offer. 'Get out and vote, then come improve your game' social frame.
pillars.coaching: Wed afternoon discounted slot (post-vote recovery pitch).

lanes.campaign: Civic-engagement content — swing-shack as part of community, not purely transactional.
lanes.search: 'indoor golf near Randburg' SEO uplift on nearby civic moments.

events.name: Singles' Day
events.commercial_push: Chinese-origin e-commerce holiday. Stick classifies this as test-only. swing-shack mirrors: small retail hook ONLY if useful. No full push. Treat as experiment slot.

pillars.retail: Single-person fitting slot — 'fit yourself a gift' midweek window.

events.name: Black Friday + Cyber Monday
events.commercial_push: Single biggest commercial moment of the SA retail calendar. 6-week runway. swing-shack retails premium brand kit (Takomo, Vice, L.A.B., LA Golf, Miura). Real retail moment — promote early and honestly. Each shopping moment carries: offer lock 10-16, creative briefs due 10-30, paid setup complete 11-13, warm-up 11-16, peak 11-27, follow-up 11-30.

events.name: December School Holiday / Family Golf
events.commercial_push: Last day of Term 4 (gov.za — 2026 Gauteng school calendar). Family / junior / parent-child golf window. Pushed from Stick's mid-Dec peak to mid-Dec Term-4-end peak so it cleanly sits before the SA-public-holiday arc. Junior coaching + parent-child session + gifting arc.

pillars.fitting: 'Family-fit' bundle: junior fitting + adult fitting in same morning.

lanes.campaign: Co-marketing with local schools (Hoërskool Randburg / Bryanston High / etc.).

events.name: Day of Reconciliation
events.commercial_push: Real SA public holiday. Open door, presence only. No commercial push.

events.name: Festive Gifting
events.commercial_push: Major retail arc. Builds BEFORE Christmas, not on the day. Overlaps Black Friday — that is intentional. Vouchers + giftable apparel + end-of-year tax-reset fit appointments + 'New Year New Bag' pitch.

pillars.retail: Apparel drop (caps, polos, socks), giftable bundles, voucher scheme.

lanes.paid: Retargeting + lookalikes from previous gift buyers.

events.name: Christmas
events.commercial_push: A-PIN END POINT. The campaign happens BEFORE this date. Christmas day itself is the close.

pillars.retail: Store closed 25 Dec; gifting arc ends 24 Dec.

lanes.campaign: Closing remarketing + 'see you 26 Dec' travel window ad.

events.name: New Year / New Bag
events.commercial_push: Sustained A/B arc. Fitting + new-equipment + coaching goals + voucher redemption + new-season golf. For swing-shack this is the 'New Year, New Swing' arc — fitting-first, equipment as the result.

pillars.fitting: Full-bag fitting surge. Putter then iron then driver — gate them in lanes, don't push them all at once.

lanes.search: Long-tail 'golf lessons JHB new year' SEO uplift.
lanes.shack-sessions: 'Start the year swinging' open-day once a week.
